description: This C# source file contains unit tests for Azure Queue streaming functionality in the Orleans framework. It sets up test fixtures, configures an in-process Orleans cluster with Azure Queue storage, and defines multiple test cases to verify streaming behaviors such as producer-consumer patterns, multiple stream scenarios, and subscription types.
